author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I spent 2 hours merging over 100 branches and workfree across in 3 repos, interlayer in git sub module with each other back to main created by my fleet of agents that the number I lost count of.

I have to do it the old fashion way in VSCode, with the terminal to see exactly what is still not committed by crashes agents.

Finally the Schrodinger's repo collapse back into reality. I don't even care the repo pass or fail, I just want to make sure everything is checked in, all work of the tokens burnt is saved in main
